items.title: Vietnam’s biggest company, Vingroup, expands overseas as its home market slows - theheraldreview.com
items.summary: # Vietnam’s biggest company, Vingroup, expands overseas as its home market slows. HANOI, Vietnam (AP) — Vietnam’s biggest conglomerate, Vingroup, is moving into global markets as business at home slows, planning nearly two dozen projects in at least 15 countries, from a “Vietnam Town” in Uzbekistan to smart cities in India and a riverfront development in Congo. But Vietnam’s once sizzling property market is cooling, while its electric vehicle company VinFast is losing money. As opportunities for large developments at home become harder to find, Vingroup, Vietnam’s largest privately owned company, is looking overseas to generate the money needed to fund its ambitions in EVs, artificial intelligence and robotics, industries central to Vietnam's goal of becoming Asia’s next tiger economy. In Uzbekistan, Vingroup signed an agreement in December to build a “Vietnam Town” in its capital, the ancient Silk Road city of Tashkent. In Central Asia’s largest metropolis, it envisions a development modeled on its signature projects in Vietnam, combining homes, shopping centers, schools, hospitals and EV charging stations.

items.title: Stock market update, July 28th: ​​Could the VN-Index break below 1,600 points? - Vietnam.vn
items.summary: # Stock market update, July 28th: ​​Could the VN-Index break below 1,600 points? ### Tien Phong Securities predicts that if selling pressure increases, the index could retreat to the strong support zone of 1,580-1,600 points before showing more reliable signs of recovery. If selling pressure increases, the index could retreat to the strong support zone of 1,580-1,600 points before a more reliable recovery signal appears. Rong Viet Securities (VDSC) believes that the VN-Index's continued failure to break through the psychological 1,700-point mark and its return to a downward trend reflects that the recent recovery is not truly sustainable and the risk of a correction remains. The index closing at its lowest point of the day on July 27th indicates that selling pressure remains dominant in the market.
